actions.action: Lift nursery pot out and check weight and soil dryness 5 cm down
Check whether soil stays damp after watering or water collects in decorative pot
Slide plant out and inspect roots for rot
Check leaf joints and crown for mealybugs
Soak nursery pot in bucket of water for 20-30 minutes then drain fully
Water whenever top half of soil is dry
If rot found, trim mushy roots and repot in potting soil with perlite
If roots circling, repot up one size in spring
If bugs found, dab with rubbing alcohol on cotton bud weekly for a month
Feed with diluted houseplant fertiliser monthly in spring and summer

reason: The answer's main diagnosis is the root ball drying out (underwatering), and its lead fix of soaking and then watering more regularly matches the poster's fix, with no harmful advice.
